pk.context: 1000 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: white to off-white, capsule-shaped, film-coated tablet with a functional score

clues.kinetics: Metabolized mainly by UGT1A6, with 75% to 90% of the dose recovered in urine within 24 hours. A high-fat meal leaves its Cmax and AUC unchanged.
clues.substance: A white to pinkish-white powder, sparingly soluble in water, with a molecular weight of 139.15.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA as 1,000 mg tablets, dosed twice a day or three times a day.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for agranulocytosis and neutropenia, which can cause serious infection and death. Contraindicated in hypersensitivity to the drug or its excipients; pyrexia and abdominal pain are common.
clues.indication: Transfusional iron overload in patients 8 years and older with thalassemia, sickle cell disease or other anemias.
clues.mechanism: A chelator with affinity for iron, forming neutral 3:1 complexes that are stable at physiological pH.

tell: An iron chelator whose boxed warning concerns agranulocytosis, with neutrophil counts to be checked before and during therapy.
